name: Federico Kirschabum
biography: is currently the CTO of Infobyte Security Research, company based in Buenos Aires, Argentina. With almost 10 years of experience researching and pentesting networks, he has developed a deep knowledge in the computer security & telecomunications field. He is one of the founders of the ekoparty security conference, one of the biggest con in Latin America which is held yearly in BA. Besides computing, Federico studied Filmmaking and worked in several productions. In his free time he loves to play competitive paintball and make asados for his friends.
